answer.rationale: Roll out shortened/simplified onboarding: it has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue under competitive pressure. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment lifted signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, indicating material downstream value destruction for the acquired cohort. The current price-cut escalation may still create residual SMB churn risk, but no verified evidence supports discounting as the durable response.
